notes.title: Snatched EA Story Mode Release
notes.notes:
Snatched EA First Large Content Update Is HERE! (Story Mode) 

Our team took less than 2 weeks and on the second week of Tuesday afternoon the update is finally out! SO to anybody that has picked up Snatched so far we hope you enjoy! If you want to stay up to date with Snatched and when more updates are coming make sure to follow our X channel (Formally Twitter) to see our road map and know what updates are to come next! GabaGoo Games X Channel


What the Story Mode Update is about?
The House
Step into the eerie and mysterious House, the centerpiece of our new update. This sprawling mansion is filled with dark secrets waiting to be uncovered. As you explore its shadowy halls on a stormy, rain-soaked night, the distant, desperate screams of your roommate echo through the corridors. What will you do? Where will you go? What happened to your roommate? Every decision you make could bring you closer to the truth or plunge you deeper into the House's sinister mysteries.

Known Bugs

 Holding cards before turn ends causes cards to become stuck - solution: exit the game.
 UI in settings menu not displaying correctly


For More information you can always Join our Discord of 256 Members
GabaGoo Games Official Discord
Or for even more information see our Website below
gabagoogames.ca


To Conclude
We hope you enjoy this exciting new update! Dive into the new maps, uncover their secrets, and immerse yourself in the enhanced storytelling experience. As always, we look forward to hearing your feedback and continuing to improve the game.

Happy exploring!
GabaGoo Games.

How To Play

We've noticed that our How To Play Section should be updated in the future with a gallery of our Cards.
In the mean time some notable tactics and hints are listed below.

- Red Highlighted Cards Are Usable
- You Must have enough Supplies To Use or Place Cards on the Battlefield
- No mans land in the center row highlighted in Yellow, both the Snatched and Victim can place cards there
- Hint► Over Time you'll figure out different ways to beat your opponent (Victim) Its best to play for multiply rounds to figure out secrets and strategies with each card. 

Enjoy!
GabaGoo Games.
